title: Laws About Restitution

questions.question: What must a thief do if he steals an ox and kills or sells it?
options: Repay five oxen for an ox
questions.correctAnswer: Repay five oxen for an ox
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:1 (ESV): "If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall repay five oxen for an ox."

questions.question: What must not be done to a sojourner (foreigner)?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:21 (ESV): "You shall not wrong a sojourner or oppress him, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Who were Israel especially commanded to protect from affliction?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:22 (ESV): "You shall not mistreat any widow or fatherless child."

questions.question: What is forbidden regarding sorcery?
options: You shall not permit a sorceress to live
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not permit a sorceress to live
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:18 (ESV): "You shall not permit a sorceress to live."

questions.question: What should be done with the firstborn of animals?
options: Give them to the Lord on the eighth day
questions.correctAnswer: Give them to the Lord on the eighth day
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:30 (ESV): "On the eighth day you shall give it to me."

questions.question: If a man lends money to a poor person, what must he not charge?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:25 (ESV): "If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be like a moneylender to him, and you shall not exact interest from him."

questions.question: What must be returned to a poor person before sunset?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:26 (ESV): "If ever you take your neighbor's cloak in pledge, you shall return it to him before the sun goes down."

questions.question: What was the penalty for offering sacrifice to any god other than the Lord?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:20 (ESV): "Whoever sacrifices to any god, other than the Lord alone, shall be devoted to destruction."

questions.question: What happens if a thief is struck and killed during a nighttime break-in?
options: There is no bloodguilt for the homeowner
questions.correctAnswer: There is no bloodguilt for the homeowner
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:2 (ESV): "If a thief is found breaking in and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no bloodguilt for him."

questions.question: What is forbidden regarding leaders of the people?
options: You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of your people
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of your people
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:28 (ESV): "You shall not revile God, nor curse a ruler of your people."

questions.question: If a thief is caught alive during daytime break-in, what must happen?
options: He must make restitution; if he has nothing, he is sold for his theft
questions.correctAnswer: He must make restitution; if he has nothing, he is sold for his theft
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:3 (ESV): "He shall surely pay. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft."

questions.question: How many sheep must a thief repay if he steals and kills a sheep?
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:1 (ESV): "And four sheep for a sheep."

questions.question: What law applied if a man seduced an unbetrothed virgin?
options: He must pay the bride-price and marry her
questions.correctAnswer: He must pay the bride-price and marry her
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:16 (ESV): "If a man seduces a virgin who is not betrothed and lies with her, he shall give the bride-price for her and make her his wife."

questions.question: What would happen if widows and orphans were afflicted and cried out to God?
options: God's wrath would burn and He would kill with the sword
questions.correctAnswer: God's wrath would burn and He would kill with the sword
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:24 (ESV): "My wrath will burn, and I will kill you with the sword, and your wives shall become widows and your children fatherless."

questions.question: Why did God say Israel should not oppress sojourners?
options: Because they were sojourners in the land of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Because they were sojourners in the land of Egypt
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:21 (ESV): "For you were sojourners in the land of Egypt."

key_verse_text: You shall not wrong a sojourner or oppress him, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
